title: Minimax Tracking of Drifting Behavioural Strategies under Identifiable Partial Observation
summary: We study high-probability tracking of a Behavioural strategy that drifts over time in an imperfect-information extensive-form game, when the strategy is observed only through a known, possibly noisy emission channel at each recognized visit to an information set.
